column1: # Farming seeds, saplings, protection payments and planting levels, read by FarmingSeeds.
# Crops are FarmingProduce names. Item ids are RuneLite gameval ItemID names with their ids; tests check every name=id pair.
#   herb     crop  seed  Farming level            one seed per patch
#   seed     crop  seed  seeds per patch
#   pay      crop  item  label  quantity           the gardener's protection payment
#   also     crop  item  label  quantity           an accepted alternative payment
# OSRS Wiki special patches table (checked 2026-10-21). A spirit tree takes three items at once
# (OSRS Wiki Spirit tree patch: 5 monkey nuts, 1 monkey bar, 1 ground suqah tooth).
# Planting levels: OSRS Wiki "Seed Table" (checked 2026-10-21) plus the hardwood levels from its special-patches table.
# Flax, hemp and cotton are not in that table: their level is unknown, so they are never filtered out.
